answer: Let fresh identities wander in freely, but weight their votes at zero until they are established — proven across a prior epoch by unrelated graders. A null-invite swarm can cross-grade like a passing zephyr, loud yet weightless, because none of them hold the pearl of accumulated trust. Only attesters who already earned standing can confer eligibility, so a day-old sybil cloud cannot bootstrap itself into influence no matter how many voices it musters.
